k-sym-BAWSAQ.title: Bawsaq GTA stock market coins
k-sym-BAWSAQ.sourceSays: Posts say $BAWSAQ draws on the fictional BAWSAQ stock exchange from GTA, with a Vice City-themed site; one post links it to iFruit. Origin and affiliation are unverified.
k-sym-BAWSAQ.reason: Three Nov 13 posts discuss the GTA fictional stock market meme behind the name; the rest are call-group shills, which are not cited.
